intent: Verify in the catalogue whether the Raaco Professional CarryLite 3CS-7A9 Shelving and Cabinet base product carries storage type both 'shelving unit' and 'stacking box', and answer <NO> with the checked SKU if the base product exists but that dual storage-type claim is absent.
success_criteria: Base product (brand Raaco, model 3CS-7A9 Shelving and Cabinet) is located in the catalogue with its product_sku and record_path.
All storage_type property values on the matched variant(s) are inspected and compared against both claimed values ('shelving unit' and 'stacking box').
Answer carries a <NO> token because the variant does not carry both claimed storage types, and explicitly names the checked SKU and cites its exact record_path.

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN pvp.property_key = 'storage_type' THEN pvp.property_value_text END) AS storage_types FROM product_variants pv LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.model = :model GROUP BY pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores

answer_template.message: Checked catalogue: Raaco Professional CarryLite 3CS-7A9 Shelving and Cabinet exists as SKU {base_product.product_sku} ({base_product.record_path}), but storage type recorded is {base_product.storage_types} only — no variant carries both 'shelving unit' and 'stacking box'. Extra catalogue claim absent. <NO> Checked SKU: {base_product.product_sku}.
